title: Delegation Receipt (Agentledger DRP Offline Profile)
description: Aligned with IETF draft-nelson-agent-delegation-receipts (-12, read 2026-10-13). Subset verified offline by agentledger; see docs/DRP-ALIGNMENT.md for the check coverage table. Profile restricts publicKey to OKP/Ed25519.

items.description: Hard prohibition 'deny:operation:resource'. Overrides any operator instruction (draft section 4.1).

operatorInstructions.description: Operator instructions verbatim; hash below is authoritative.

receiptId.description: rec_ + hex(sha256(canonical body without receiptId / canonicalPayload / signature)).

canonicalPayload.description: base64url (no padding) of the canonicalized body including receiptId, excluding canonicalPayload and signature.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (base64url, no padding) over the canonicalPayload bytes.

revocationRequired.description: If true, a verifier without a revocation source MUST deny with REVOCATION_CHECK_REQUIRED (draft section 6.6).

orchestratorSignature.description: Ed25519 (base64url) by the sub-receipt's own key over 'orchestrator-delegation:{parentReceiptId}:{receiptId}'. Outside the signed body (draft section 10.1).

resource.description: Resource pattern; '*' and '/*' wildcards supported by agentledger.
